63:t_1:260.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...They've received a report from $$アルト$$'s reconnaissance team. A large force of pirates is approaching the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

63:t_1:262.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...So the day has finally come...」

63:t_1:266.en: ～ $$ガルガンティア船団$$ / Fleet Commander's Room ～

63:t_1:267.en:
$$リジット$$
「...According to the reconnaissance team's report, the pirate force is expected to reach the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ around midnight tonight.」

63:t_1:268.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「It's too late to change course now...」

63:t_1:269.en:
$$フランジ$$
「Fleet Commander... Wasn't allowing those people called $c to stay here the cause of all this?」

63:t_1:271.en:
$$リジット$$
「I agree. They did protect the fleet, but $$サイデリアル$$ came here to target them in the first place.」

63:t_1:273.en:
$$リジット$$
「I hear the approaching pirates are flying a lobster flag.」

63:t_1:274.en:
$$クラウン$$
「The great pirate $$ラケージ$$...」

63:t_1:275.en:
$$リジット$$
「I'm told she is a proud woman known as the Empress. She likely intends to make a name for herself by attacking us after we drove off $$サイデリアル$$.」

63:t_1:276.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「But expelling them will not solve the problem.」

63:t_1:277.en:
$$フランジ$$
「Even if $c's strength drives off $$ラケージ$$, they will leave eventually. If something like this happens again afterward...」

63:t_1:282.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ベローズ$$ told me about the situation. ...Including the fact that we are the cause of this pirate attack.」

63:t_1:283.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「You needn't worry about that. Those pirates would have attacked this fleet eventually. You were merely the trigger.」

63:t_1:284.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But we are now members of the $$ガルガンティア船団$$. Please allow us to address this problem as people living alongside you, rather than as guests.」

63:t_2:6.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Good work, everyone. Especially you, Captain $$テスタロッサ$$...」

63:t_2:9.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「I never imagined you'd put $$ラケージ$$ in her place like that...」

63:t_2:10.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「But are you sure you'll be all right? She's going to be targeting you from now on.」

63:t_2:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Besides, I... have no intention of losing.」

63:t_2:14.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Of course. $$テッサ$$ is the captain of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and everyone's commanding officer, after all.」

63:t_2:15.en:
$$リジット$$
「We thank $c and $$レド$$ for their cooperation. With the threats of $$サイデリアル$$ and the pirates gone, we formally approve your stay with this fleet.」

63:t_2:16.en:
$$エイミー$$
「That can wait! Breakfast comes first!」

63:t_2:19.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We've earned it after all that work. I'm going to eat a ton!」

63:t_2:20.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Come on, $$レド$$. I'll treat you.」

63:t_2:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「I was thinking... I think we'll be able to get along with $$レド$$.」

63:t_2:28.en:
$n
「Yeah. At least becoming friends should go more smoothly than it did with you.」

63:t_2:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「I could say exactly the same to you.」

63:t_2:30.en:
$n
「You and I both changed. I'm sure he can too.」

63:t_2:31.en:
$$アルト$$
「What are you two grinning about? Let's go eat.」

63:t_2:33.en:
$$アルト$$
「$n and I will go ahead. $$宗介$$, show Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ the way.」

63:t_2:35.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're coming with me. That's an order from your club president, Vice President.」

63:t_2:38.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...It seems $$アルト$$ was trying to be considerate of us.」

63:t_2:40.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm sorry about yesterday... You saw me at my worst...」

63:t_2:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「But you fulfilled your responsibilities splendidly, Captain.」

63:t_2:42.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...I wasn't confident at all, really. But when I entered the command center, the way everyone looked at me reminded me...」

63:t_2:43.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm more than just an ordinary girl... By taking that seat, I took on the responsibility of leading everyone to victory.」

63:t_2:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So I gave it everything I had. For the people who trust and follow me... And above all, for my own pride.」

63:t_2:46.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I think I was feeling a little vulnerable... That's why I leaned on you a little, $$相良$$...」

63:t_2:47.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I... lose control around you, $$相良$$... I even became hysterical when you were relieved of your duty to guard $$カナメ$$...」

63:t_2:49.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm always thinking of myself without considering your feelings, $$相良$$... I'm sorry...」

63:t_2:50.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... I should be the one apologizing. I didn't consider your feelings either, Captain.」

63:t_2:53.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Thank you, $$相良$$... You mean a great deal to me.」

63:t_2:54.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Captain, if you consider me a friend, would you permit me to say something a little forward?」
